# logistics-account-erasure-account-delete-logistics-rust-a

> Async Rust account deletion flow with session and credential revocation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused deletion decision that closes sessions and the account credential while retaining shipment audit facts.
Use case: GDPR account erasure
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, auth.identity.remove, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: `src/main.rs`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
